datasets.label: MMLU-Pro
datasets.path_hypothesis: Independent question generation can use full-attention KV, but a single fresh prompt does not prove cached multi-token continuing-prefill. Record cache hits and eligible dispatches before attributing a speedup to this mechanism.
datasets.sample_count_scope: Snapshot row counts and the formal evaluation task manifest still need to be extracted; the historical serving command used 200 prompts and is not the dataset cardinality.
datasets.primary_metric: Task accuracy under a pinned evaluator

shared_progress.summary: Pinned MMLU-Pro scorer and a PyramidKV 70-task compatibility pair exist. These are neither full-dataset scores nor AQKV results. The PyramidKV 4096-token eligibility and selection policy must not be inherited.

current_blockers.required_input: Local official-source identity, exact Qwen3.5 tokenizer/context audit, source-bound scoring and stored raw request/response normalization are prepared. Review selection/generation/scorer contract and verify serving token parity plus actual bounded B0/B1 transport; stored-record validation is not transport proof. The 70-task synthetic fixtures are not model evidence; do not inherit PyramidKV activation or eligibility.
Canonical review of the AQKV task/scorer/runtime contract, real target-path and correctness receipts, and a reachable assigned environment.

canonical_blockers.required_input: Extract and freeze the full task manifest, row counts, sampling rule, pinned scorer, and execution environment from the verified snapshot.
Produce task-accuracy evidence; the existing artifact contains serving telemetry only.

datasets.label: HLE-Verified
datasets.path_hypothesis: Verified questions can exercise full-attention KV; judge inference must be separated from the target-model arm. Long reasoning alone does not prove prefix-cache hits or continuing-prefill dispatch.
datasets.split: Gold, Revision, and Uncertain JSONL subsets
datasets.sample_count_scope: Gold 668, Revision 1143, and Uncertain 689; local objects match the upstream Git LFS SHA-256 values.
datasets.primary_metric: Accuracy under the pinned HLE-Verified evaluator

shared_progress.summary: All 2500 source rows have an audit implementation; Gold has 668 tasks including 93 image-bearing tasks. The other MOD service image limit is zero, not a verified constraint of our environment.

current_blockers.required_input: Canonical rights review, named full/Gold task scope, pinned judge and image-aware solver/scorer/environment contract.
Verify image handling on the accepted target runtime; do not silently discard image tasks or leak rationale images into solver inputs.

canonical_blockers.required_input: Upstream does not declare a dataset license; complete license review before formal execution.
Choose and freeze the evaluated subset, task manifest, judge model and prompts, scorer, and execution image.

datasets.label: SWE-bench-Pro
datasets.path_hypothesis: Agent tool-result turns may extend a cached conversation and exercise continuing-prefill. The agent/tool budget, repository and fresh-sandbox regrader must remain identical; observe the path instead of assuming every turn hits it.
datasets.split: default, hard, and v1 test Parquet snapshots
datasets.sample_count_scope: Snapshot files are frozen; task IDs and repository/image mapping must be extracted into the formal execution manifest.
datasets.primary_metric: Resolved task rate in isolated regrading

shared_progress.summary: The shared V2 audit covers 642 tasks, repo revisions, harness bytes and AMD64 image metadata. Root-license identification does not grant task rights; preserve the documented harness CRLF difference.

current_blockers.required_input: Task rights review, assigned AMD64 fresh-sandbox backend, and pinned agent/tool/budget/regrader/runtime contract.
Integrate the reviewed repo/image mapping and preserve exact harness bytes, complete task failures and real AQKV-path receipts.

canonical_blockers.required_input: Upstream does not declare a dataset-card license; complete license review before formal execution.
Freeze task IDs, code repository revisions, fresh-sandbox image digests, agent scaffold, tool policy, budget, and regrader.

datasets.label: FrontierScience
datasets.path_hypothesis: Both tracks may use full-attention KV, but their scoring contracts differ. Keep Olympiad and Research separate and record eligible continuing-prefill dispatches per track.
datasets.sample_count_scope: Olympiad 100 and Research 60; the tracks remain separate in formal reporting.

shared_progress.summary: Separate 100/60 source-row inventories and candidate solver/grader code exist. Research's 59 unique group IDs must not deduplicate its 60 rows. This is not the official judge protocol or semantic calibration.

current_blockers.required_input: Review the separate track protocol; provide an actually available pinned judge and passing semantic calibration bound before solver outputs, plus the execution environment.
Use track/source-row identities, preserve null scores on incomplete grading, and verify our runtime arms without inheriting PyramidKV applicability.

canonical_blockers.required_input: Freeze separate Olympiad and Research task manifests, scorers, and execution environment.

datasets.label: Terminal-Bench 2.1
datasets.path_hypothesis: Agent/tool history may produce continuing-prefill on the target server. Harbor task resolution is the primary result; runtime images and tool budgets cannot be changed to manufacture a throughput gain.
datasets.sample_count_scope: Task definitions and harness metadata are frozen; approximately 40 GB of runtime images were intentionally not pre-pulled.

shared_progress.summary: Task/image metadata audits and a Harbor 0.24.0 candidate plan exist. A local 55-input/23-output model call has no sandbox, verifier or task score; job-b0 does not switch server activation.

current_blockers.required_input: Assigned AMD64 Docker/Harbor backend, effective resource limits, image layers pinned by digest, actual backend-to-model connectivity/authentication and task rights/canonical review.
Verify fresh-sandbox reference/failure/verifier behavior and actual AQKV B0/B1 runtime activation; preserve nested request retries and task policies.

canonical_blockers.required_input: Pull and freeze all required Harbor runtime image digests; the task snapshot alone is not executable.
Freeze the agent scaffold, tool policy, budget, scorer, and task-level third-party rights review.
